solutions.title: Solution spaces for different needs
solutions.description: Start with the need, not a technology list. We can choose the most relevant space and develop it in practical stages.

build.erp: Bring operational processes and important data together in a tailored ERP.
build.pos: Manage sales transactions with a POS flow that is easy to use.
build.inventory: Track stock, product movement, and restocking needs from one system.
build.dashboard: Turn data into a clear view that supports decision-making.
build.admin: Manage content, users, and operations through an admin panel.
build.website: Present information, services, or products through a fast, clear website.
build.custom: Build a custom business system around the workflow people actually use.
build.api: Connect services and data so they work together through APIs.

automate.workflow: Reduce manual steps with workflows that run consistently.
automate.ai: Apply AI where it is relevant and can remain supervised.
automate.integration: Connect separate systems for cleaner data exchange.
automate.data: Automate repetitive data processing and reporting.
automate.device: Explore device automation for specific operational needs.
automate.repetitive: Move repetitive work out of the way so teams can focus on higher-value tasks.

create.identity: Develop a clear visual identity that can grow.
create.media: Design digital media for its context and audience.
create.content: Shape content that is clear and consistent.
create.experience: Create digital experiences that are engaging and useful.

explore.research: Study context, users, and possibilities before choosing a direction.
explore.prototype: Turn an idea into a small prototype that can be evaluated.
explore.concept: Test concepts to identify risks and opportunities early.
explore.technology: Explore technology with a clear, real-world purpose.

improve.process: Find process friction and design a simpler flow.
improve.ux: Improve an experience so it is easier to understand and use.
improve.performance: Improve the speed and reliability of a digital product.
improve.existing: Develop an existing solution without unnecessarily starting over.

process.title: Building through an open process
process.description: Every need is different. This is an adaptable framework, not a rigid sequence.

1.title: Share the problem or idea
1.description: We begin with context, needs, friction, or a possibility you want to explore.

2.title: We study the need
2.description: We explore goals, users, constraints, and what already exists.

3.title: We design possible solutions
3.description: We consider approaches along with their value, risks, and scope.

4.title: The solution is built and tested
4.description: We build in stages and test against relevant use cases.

5.title: We develop the result together
5.description: Feedback and learning guide the next improvement or direction.

privacy.title: Clear about privacy from the start.
privacy.description: This page explains the information Pangkreas may receive when you contact us and how that information is handled.

collected.title: Data we collect
collected.description: If the conversation form is available and you use it, we may receive your name, business or organization, email, WhatsApp number, need category, message, target timeline, locale, and page source. Optional fields do not need to be completed.

purpose.title: How we use it
purpose.description: The information is used to understand your needs, respond to questions, assess a possible collaboration, and continue the communication you requested.

processing.title: How data is processed
processing.description: Data is processed only as needed to handle an inquiry. We do not sell contact information or use it for unrelated purposes without consent.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.description: Data is kept while it is reasonably needed for communication and administration, then reviewed for deletion. A specific retention period will be set before the public form is enabled.

protection.title: Protecting information
protection.description: We use reasonable safeguards and limit access to inquiry information. No storage or transmission method can be guaranteed to be entirely risk-free.

thirdParty.title: Third-party services
thirdParty.description: If third-party form, storage, email, or analytics services are used in the future, this section will be updated to explain their role. No vendor is named before one has been selected.

rights.title: Your choices and rights
rights.description: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of data you previously submitted, where it remains available and is not required to be kept for a legitimate reason.

contact.title: Contacting Pangkreas
contact.description: Privacy requests can be sent through a channel shown on the Start a Conversation page. Contact details appear only after they have been confirmed and configured by the owner of Pangkreas.

privacy.note: This policy will be reviewed before the form and third-party services are enabled. Material changes will be reflected on this page.

contact.title: Tell us about your need, problem, or idea.
contact.description: You do not need a perfect brief. Share the context and we can begin exploring the possibilities together.
contact.alternative: You can also tell us about your needs directly by email. We’ll get back to you as soon as possible.
contact.formUnavailable: The conversation form is being prepared. In the meantime, you can reach Pangkreas through the available contact channel.
contact.noChannels: No contact channel is currently available.
